title: Best Community Managers (2026): Grow Online Communities
description: How to hire an online community manager for Discord, forums, groups or brand communities: moderation, engagement, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Online community managers build and look after spaces where your customers or fans talk to each other: Discord servers, forums, social groups, membership platforms or customer communities. Good community management creates helpful conversations, loyal members and useful feedback. Communities go wrong when rules are missing, moderation is slow, or the community is used only for promotion. This guide helps you hire someone who grows a healthy community.

faq.q: Which platforms do community managers handle?
faq.a: Common ones include Discord, forums, social groups and membership tools. Ask for experience with yours.
Welcoming members, starting discussions, moderating, answering questions, running events and reporting insights.
It depends on size and activity. Active communities may need daily attention, including weekends.

faq.q: How do we handle difficult members?
faq.a: With clear rules, consistent moderation and an agreed process for warnings and removals.
Active members, helpful discussions, retention and feedback that improves your product or service.
